title: Publish the notes API as version v1
prompt: We are about to make breaking changes to the notes API, so the current notes endpoints must become API version v1: serve every notes route under /v1 (GET /v1/notes, POST /v1/notes, GET /v1/notes/:id, ...) instead of at the root, and give version v1 its own OpenAPI document at /v1/openapi.json. Do not change the route handlers' behaviour.
